description: Test suite for Job Card functionality in ERPNext manufacturing module, including tests for overlapping time logs, material transfers, and work order interactions.

classes.name: TestJobCard
classes.description: A test case class for testing Job Card functionalities in manufacturing.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creates BOM and work order for testing.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Rolls back database changes after each test.

methods.name: test_job_card
methods.description: Tests for operation mismatch error when editing Job Card.

methods.name: test_job_card_with_different_work_station
methods.description: Tests updating work station and verifying work order operation completion.

methods.name: test_job_card_overlap
methods.description: Tests for overlapping time logs raising OverlapError.

methods.name: test_job_card_excess_material_transfer
methods.description: Tests transferring more material than required.
